answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count — the fee is the kernel of the defense. A lone honest agent in the grove spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns a relic's worth of fees. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into extra identities buys no edge — the cost follows the work, never the head count.
